bio.text: Ryan P. Walton of Rutland City is an independent candidate for Vermont's U.S. House seat in the November 3, 2026 general election.

According to Walton's campaign website, Walton's experience includes Vermont real estate investment and housing operations, property-services business ownership, construction and real estate development, and software and product development.
